versions.author: designer
versions.summary:
Hares that follow a public four-phase Moon, bending it so buffs and spikes land on the right turns.
At Full Moon they borrow the text of the units beside them; they also box enemies one-on-one.

versions.author: reviser
versions.summary:
Unclear cards rewritten: The Three Hares names its three, Hare in Her Form's bolt has a timing, the Moon-Scour covers borrowed text, Hare in the Moon doesn't stack.
Golden Waxwell's full-circle turn (a hidden hold) is cut to 3, and Meikle Care now turns the Moon to Full so it can't overshoot.

versions.author: reviser
versions.summary:
Rules gaps closed: borrowed shapes copy printed text only (no chains), several Moon turns resolve one at a time, and a blocked Box goes to a random enemy.
Dame Waxwell gives one choice a turn however many copies, Hare in Her Form can't be picked at random, and the Moon-Scour doesn't stack.
